fields.artifact_files: list[string] — filenames making up the artifact
fields.artifact_json: string — JSON object mapping each filename to its contents
fields.atlas_digest: string — content digest; rows are only comparable at equal digest
fields.atlas_version: string — the atlas release this row came from
fields.caught_by: string — the check that is supposed to reject it; empty if valid
fields.defect: string — defect key; empty for valid cases
fields.severity: string — soundness | integrity | vacuity; empty for valid cases
fields.title: string — one-line description of the mutation; empty for valid cases
fields.valid: bool — whether a correct verifier should ACCEPT this artifact
fields.why_it_looks_valid: string — why a naive verifier would accept it; empty if valid
